document.title: fix(sdk): a pad button handler that re-renders runs once per press
document.summary: `dispatchPadButton` iterates a copy of its subscriber Set, so a handler whose re-render re-subscribes no longer runs again in the same dispatch; an SDK unit test reproduces the loop through a legacy-root renderer.
document.why: In minesweeper, Cross presses sometimes do nothing and switching Deck Apps from the Shell hangs ([task](source:s2)).

sources.label: PR #135
sources.title: fix(sdk): a pad button handler that re-renders runs once per press
sources.gist: Root cause, fix, regression test, Vita3K before/after proof and benchmark.

sources.label: Claude Code session · Oct 26
sources.gist: Máté reports that Cross on a minesweeper cell sometimes does nothing and that switching Deck Apps from the Shell hangs, and asks for the root cause, a minimal fix and a regression test.

lookFor: The task suspected today's perf PRs (#129, #133, #130, #128); none of them is changed here, because the loop lives in `pad-buttons.ts`, unchanged since #83 ([PR](source:s1)).

groups.title: Dispatch iterates a snapshot
groups.why: One Triangle press in minesweeper re-ran `reset` forever, which froze the JS thread: later Cross presses were never handled, and `js_runtime_stop` joined a thread that never stopped ([task](source:s2)).
groups.summary: The test's `Counter` calls `setState` twice in a Triangle handler, which is the pattern that made `dispatchPadButton`'s live-Set loop visit the subscriber `usePadButton` re-added mid-dispatch.
lookFor: Subtle: a subscriber removed during a dispatch (its component re-rendered or unmounted) still gets that press with its previous closure, and one added during the dispatch waits for the next press.
The test's `presses > 10` guard turns the infinite loop on `main` into a fast failure ("the press is dispatched again and again") instead of a hung test run.

groups.title: Run and typecheck SDK tests in test/
groups.why: Enables the regression test in the dispatch group to run in CI and `agent-check.sh fast`.
groups.summary: `test:cli` also runs `test/*.test.tsx`, `tsconfig.json` typechecks that folder, and `react-reconciler` with its types joins the SDK's devDependencies from the existing catalog.

groups.title: Failure screen golden
groups.why: The smoke failure screen prints a minified runtime.js stack frame, so the fix moves its column and CI smoke failed on this golden.
groups.summary: Regenerated output: only the stack frame column changes, to runtime.js:24:9126, so the reader can skip it.

commits.subject: fix(sdk): a pad button handler that re-renders runs once per press
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
dispatchPadButton iterated the live subscriber Set. A handler with two
setState calls flushes the first render's effects in React's legacy root,
so usePadButton unsubscribed and subscribed again mid-dispatch, and the
loop visited the new subscriber: the minesweeper Triangle reset ran
forever, the JS thread stopped handling input, and stopping it for a
Deck App switch never returned.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
